text_x: GSR: Most DAOs Hold Around 70% of Treasury Assets in Native Tokens, Creating Negative Feedback Loops According to the report from GSR, crypto treasury management has major structural flaws. Most DAOs hold around 70% of their treasury assets in their own native tokens, causing treasury value, protocol revenue, and market activity to decline simultaneously and creating a procyclical negative feedback loop. Projects often seek hedging only after token prices fall, when implied volatility has already risen and protection becomes costly. The report recommends separating operational reserves from long-term holdings and using collar structures to obtain downside protection at zero cost, extending projects' runway during bear markets. — link

text_x: Robinhood Eco Update $CASHCAT (100 mil) - listing makes the trade is different now, there's no longer a main catalyst and you need to have a mid/longer time horizon. You have to believe in RH's ability to convert mindshare and real users to their chain and crypto products. From history we can tell that all mentions are intentional from the team regarding Cashcat and it's also safe to assume that hints for other coins probably have deeper meaning. Not good to ascribe your thesis to that but worth noting. I do think it probably bleeds a little more from this 100 mil area while attention rotates to Stonkbroker or runners on different chains. Worth being patient now as the main catalyst is gone, the 50-70 mil area is what I'm targeting depending on how fast and why we get there. Still a trade I'm very interested to re enter at the right level. $STONKBROKER (45 mil) - the sleeper utility play with zero pullbacks. #3 revenue driver to the chain behind Uni and Pons, 405k in stocks distributed, still quite a few products to be released. Currently has NFT AMM with 4444 stock brokers, a lending desk, a stock token casino, a liquidity locker, a token launchpad, a DEX and options desk. The NFTs are quite cool with design and embedded with the eco's philosophy of distribution and flywheel. 67% of NFTs are choosing to have their rewards paid in the native token. Token is erc 20 which is designed to have better chance of listings due to no mints. While Stonkbroker feels like the everything eco and I like it much more than Pons, it does feel like it's getting close to an attention top in the coming days, granted Vlad or the RH team don't endorse. The founder is pretty cracked and well connected, what worries me the most is how many moving parts they're working on. They've been in testnet for several months on all of these products, building on Arbitrums stack then ported over to RH. As someone who was previously working on an eco of similar/greater magnitude, a lot of shit goes wrong when building several products all launching on similar timeframes. Back then my team didn't have Fable so the environment isn't the same, however the same principle applies. I'd be hesitate buying given the current conditions, mindshare and roadmap releases at this stage. I do like it though and think it has a lot of potential if the product launches and flywheels continue to be successful. $STONK (8 mil) - Stonkbroker launchpad which pairs tokens with stocks, memes, stables, ETFs, essentially vamping Long XYZ. So far their main runner is Butthole which is paired to Anthropic, already hit 5 mil and doing considerably well. They even made a Manlet vamp which uses Ansem as the underlying token. Think we continue to see more experiments like this and becomes a staple for onchain. 240k revenue, 60% revenue goes to Stonk buyback (140k bought and 150k burned so far). Teams adding more features day by day. Not something I'm interested in this late. $MANCER (10 mil) - new automated order execution. Stonk Exchange creates the marketplace and liquidity. Mancer lets you leave instructions for how and when to trade against a marketplace. Basically a Jupiter using Uni v3 and aggregation isn't great yet. The mechanism does have some novelty in how it calculates price and twaps in pools/blocks. Also using keeper NFTs to flywheel the token like Stonkbroker. Not really that interested in it from its current perspective. $DERP (1 mil) - also hit 10 mil fdv before circulating was adjusted and another stonkbroker coin. Derp is the mined token of StonkPit, a browser proof of work game. Clock a broker in, your browser grinds sha256 at the same fixed rate for everyone and each accepted proof prints Derp. Basically a decentralized randomness oracle, not a price oracle. Can power lotteries, casino/gacha games, randomized NFT rewards, game outcomes, etc. Not overly interesting but circulating mcap was sitting below 500k for a good amount of time. Just on that alone it feels a bit cheap compared to other plays, although demand for ponzinomics has mostly dissipated.

text_x: Brazil to Delay Certain Crypto Transfers Over $10,000 for Up to 24 Hours According to Reuters, Brazil's central bank will introduce new anti-fraud rules for crypto assets starting next year. Transfers of more than $10,000 to overseas virtual asset service providers or self-custody wallets may be delayed for up to 24 hours. The threshold may apply to either a single transaction or a customer's cumulative transfers in one day. Other transactions requiring further review under risk management policies may also be delayed. The central bank said the measures aim to address the rapid transfer of proceeds from financial fraud through virtual assets, including stablecoins. It added that the measures do not constitute an asset freeze and will not permanently block transfers. — link
